general: Ashe has no one-item spike and her Q needs four stacks, so before level 6 she mostly has only Volley in a fight; avoid all-ins early unless Q is stacked (hitting towers keeps stacks ready). In lane, mix last hits with W poke at its long range and zone with slows, but respect that she has no mobility and is very gankable. The author says not to expect to win lane hard before roughly minutes 15-20: play safe, freeze and farm while she scales. After Essence Reaver plus a first crit item her ultimate comes up much more often, so use it freely to pick or save teammates; in 1v1s slow the target first and fire R from close range. Red buff makes chasing much easier once ahead, and Hawkshot vision should be used constantly for map info.
